reddit.title: Exciting Updates in Provincia: Multilingual Support and Improved Placement Feedback
reddit.body: We're thrilled to announce that our build UI now supports ten languages! This means a smoother experience for players around the world. Additionally, we've improved our placement feedback system to clearly indicate why a placement may have failed, ensuring you can build your colony with confidence. Plus, transitions between day and night are now seamless, enhancing your gameplay experience. Learn more about these updates here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ten-locales-clearer-placement?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ten-locales-clearer-placement

steam.title: Provincia Update: Multilingual Support and Enhanced Placement Feedback
steam.body: We're excited to announce that Provincia's build UI now supports ten languages! This update is designed to create a more inclusive experience for players globally. We've also improved our placement feedback system to provide clearer reasons for placement failures, making it easier for you to build your colony. Additionally, transitions between day and night are now smoother than ever. For more details, check out our latest dev talk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ten-locales-clearer-placement?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ten-locales-clearer-placement
